# Snipsy

Snipsy is a text-expansion plugin for Obsidian: type a trigger and a space,
get the text. Hotstrings, fields you fill with Tab ($1, $2), a searchable
snippet picker, community packages, and imports from Espanso and the Text
Snippets plugin (tab stops and non-Latin triggers included). Commands:
Insert snippet, Add snippet from selection, Expand trigger at cursor, Next
field, Open settings. It knows where markdown is code, so it stays quiet in
code blocks, inline code, math and frontmatter.

Site: https://dimagious.github.io/snipsidian/
Repository: https://github.com/Dimagious/snipsidian
Community plugin listing: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/snipsidian
Plugin id: snipsidian
